fusions.name: Rotted Through
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A strike that deals 16 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Riffled Spores
fusions.desc: Riffles open a mildewed volume, releasing spores in a cone 5 tiles ahead that deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores resistances and leaves each target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Mouldering Stack
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set down a mouldering stack of books beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spotted Endpapers
fusions.desc: Every hit you land leaves a spot of mould on that enemy, up to 8. At 8 they all burst at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per spot (218% at full). Unfed, a spot fades every 4 seconds.
